description: This file contains the implementation of the Partition class within the AWS SDK for PHP, defining the behavior and data for AWS partitions including endpoint resolution, region matching, and other partition-specific logic.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: A class representing an AWS partition, handling endpoint resolution, region matching, and related partition data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Partition object with specified definition array, initializing partition data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the partition.

methods.name: getDnsSuffix
methods.description: Returns the DNS suffix for the partition.

methods.name: isRegionMatch
methods.description: Checks if a region matches the region patterns or definitions within this partition.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Returns available endpoints for a given service, optionally allowing non-regional endpoints.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Generates a partition endpoint URL and related metadata for specified service and region.

methods.name: getEndpointData
methods.description: Retrieves endpoint data for a specific service and region.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Determines the signature version to use based on endpoint data.

methods.name: resolveRegion
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate region, considering global and legacy endpoints.

methods.name: isServicePartitionGlobal
methods.description: Checks if a service is a global, non-regionalized service.

methods.name: isStsLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if an STS legacy endpoint should be used based on options and region.

methods.name: isS3LegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if a legacy S3 endpoint should be used based on options and region.

methods.name: getPartitionEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the partition endpoint for a given service.

methods.name: formatEndpoint
methods.description: Formats an endpoint URL using a template and parameters.

methods.name: isFipsEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if a FIPS endpoint is used in the specified region.

methods.name: getVariant
methods.description: Determines the endpoint variant based on options such as use_fips_endpoint and use_dual_stack_endpoint.
